Container.Name: mcp-mediamanager
Container.Overview: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that connects Claude.ai to your media stack: Sonarr, Radarr, Tautulli, and Overseerr. Ask Claude to add shows and movies, check what's airing, see who's streaming, manage requests, and more. Each service is optional — only configure the ones you use.

Config.Name: AppData Path
Config.Description: Where to store persistent config (API keys, URLs, etc.). Settings are saved here so they survive container updates — just like Sonarr's AppData folder.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Port the MCP server listens on. Use this port when configuring Claude.ai remote MCP. Defaults to 3001 to avoid conflict with mcp-ynab on 3000.

Config.Name: MCP Auth Token (Secret)
Config.Description: A secret token to protect your MCP endpoint. Set any long random string here and use the same value when configuring Claude.ai. Leave blank to disable auth (not recommended if exposed to the internet).

Config.Name: MCP Client ID
Config.Description: OAuth client ID used alongside the auth token. You can leave this as 'mcp-mediamanager'.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: URL of your Sonarr instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8989. Leave blank to disable Sonarr tools.

Config.Name: Sonarr API Key
Config.Description: Sonarr API key — found in Sonarr → Settings → General → API Key.

Config.Name: Radarr URL
Config.Description: URL of your Radarr instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:7878. Leave blank to disable Radarr tools.

Config.Name: Radarr API Key
Config.Description: Radarr API key — found in Radarr → Settings → General → API Key.

Config.Name: Tautulli URL
Config.Description: URL of your Tautulli instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8181. Leave blank to disable Tautulli tools.

Config.Name: Tautulli API Key
Config.Description: Tautulli API key — found in Tautulli → Settings → Web Interface → API Key.

Config.Name: Overseerr URL
Config.Description: URL of your Overseerr instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:5055. Leave blank to disable Overseerr tools.

Config.Name: Overseerr API Key
Config.Description: Overseerr API key — found in Overseerr → Settings → General → API Key.
